objective: Turn the Thorium Brotherhood Contract in to Lokhtos Darkbargainer if you would like to receive the plans for Sulfuron.

description: The undersigned hereby declares that the Sulfuron ingot they are delivering to the Thorium Brotherhood (TB Ltd.) is genuine and not a facsimile thereof. The undersigned also acknowledges that any harm that should come to him/her as a result of attempting to build, forge, find, create, sell, or eat Sulfuras, is not the responsibility or fault of TB Ltd.
By signing this contract, you are agreeing to all terms listed herein.
completion: It has been a pleasure doing business with you, <name>!
On behalf of TB Ltd., I wish you luck in your search for Sulfuras!

note: Blacksmithing. Bring a Sulfuron Ingot (Golemagg, Molten Core) to Lokhtos in the Grim Guzzler to get the contract, then hand it back for the Sulfuron Hammer plans.
pickup: Thorium Brotherhood Contract (from Lokhtos Darkbargainer with a Sulfuron Ingot)
turnin: Lokhtos Darkbargainer, Grim Guzzler, Blackrock Depths
